hughowen_librarian.text: Quiet please. Well, studious. Welcome to the Hugh Owen Library.
It is named after Sir Hugh Owen, who spent his life campaigning for proper schools and colleges in Wales. He helped found the university here.
In 1919 Aberystwyth set up the first chair of International Politics anywhere in the world, to study how to avoid another war. Quite a good idea, really.

hughowen_reader.text: It is exam season. Shh. A gull sat on the windowsill all morning and I swear it was reading over my shoulder.
